# pUNC Documentation

> The Polytoria Unified Naming Convention (pUNC) is a standardized API specification and execution environment standard designed for the Polytoria Luau executor ecosystem.

## Overview

- [Introduction](https://punc.quaternion.vip/): Introduction to pUNC philosophy, compliance badge, and test suite runner.

## API Modules

- [System](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/system): System information, identity, executor metadata, and clipboard APIs.
- [Environment](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/environment): Global environment manipulation.
- [Metatable](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/metatable): Read-only state management, metatable inspection, and metamethod interception.
- [Closures](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/closures): C/Luau closure manipulation, function hooking, newcclosure, clonefunction, and upvalue/constant utilities.
- [Debug](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/debug): Luau debug library extensions for inspecting stacks, upvalues, constants, and protos.
- [Filesystem](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/filesystem): Sandboxed filesystem operations.
- [Scripts](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/scripts): Script execution, bytecode decompilation, disassembly, and script environment utilities.
- [Instances](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/instances): Polytoria game object query and manipulation APIs.
- [Signals](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/signals): Signal connection manipulation and firing.
- [Input](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/input): Virtual input simulation.
- [Cryptography](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/cryptography): Hashing and AES encryption/decryption utilities.
- [Encoding](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/encoding): Base64 and URL encoding/decoding utilities.
- [HTTP Networking](https://punc.quaternion.vip/docs/http): HTTP requests and networking utilities.

## Compliance Suite

- [pUNCCheck.lua](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PolyQuaternion/pUNC/refs/heads/main/pUNCCheck.lua): Standardized test suite validating executor compliance, type fidelity, round-trip transformations, and error handling.
